title: Jacobs and Hopkins conclude abductions began mid-to-late 1800s

tellings.quote: he and Bud Hopkins had concluded that the abduction that the abduction phenomenon began in the mid to late 1800s

plain: Two researchers of alien abduction, the reports of people who say nonhuman beings took them, are said to have concluded that the phenomenon only began in the mid to late 1800s. The researchers are David Jacobs and Budd Hopkins. A guest named Tim Alberino tells Michels this, repeating what Jacobs told him. If it were true, the abductions would have a starting point in modern history and not go back forever.
